definition: A pack an ancestor of this style binds, which this style's own record asks to receive by name. Some packs reach a style only on request; opting in records that someone read what descent would bring and wanted this one.
basis: Our wording of the style record's opt-in list and the pack's opt-in delivery. schema/style-node.schema.json, inherits_packs description: "Pack ids this node OPTS IN to receiving by descent."; schema/style-node.schema.json, inherits_packs description: "this one records a person reading it and wanting one"; schema/proportion-pack.schema.json, delivery description: "`opt-in` means it reaches a node only where the node binds it or names it in its own `inherits_packs`."; docs/inheritance.md: "a pack may declare `delivery: opt-in`, and then it arrives only at a node whose own record names it in `inherits_packs`.".
